title: 远景科技Ricky Jung：AI数据中心客户是谁？ hyperscaler之后还有谁？
speaker: Ricky Jung

segments.en: Okay, interesting. Can you tell us a bit more about who your clients currently? I know you can't name individual names, but can you tell us a bit more about the tenet mix that you've seen so far? Is it mostly hyperscalers or AI compute providers? Can you tell us a bit more what the mix looks like now?
segments.zh: 有意思。能多谈谈目前的客户构成吗？我知道不能点名，但主要客户类型是超大规模云厂商还是AI算力提供商？现在客户组合大致如何？

segments.en: Yeah, actually, I stopped from the hyperscaler, of course. Yeah, they bring a lot of computing powers to in Omogolia, especially WLAN Cup, but following followed by a lot of other players such as the language large model companies.
segments.zh: 当然，我们从超大规模云厂商说起，他们带来了大量算力，尤其是在乌兰察布，随后还有很多其他参与者，比如大语言模型公司。

segments.en: For now, we also meet some of the vertical integration of vertical usage kind of industries of companies such as autonomous driving and some of the content generation, as well as we also see a lot of industry companies such as renewable power or other like car EV manufacturing companies.
segments.zh: 目前我们也接触到一些垂直行业公司，如自动驾驶、内容生成，以及可再生能源、电动汽车制造等行业的公司。

segments.en: They are also trying to lease off the data center for their internal use.
segments.zh: 他们也在尝试租赁数据中心供内部使用。

segments.en: Okay, and so take us beyond the current project, Ricky, where else, whether that's within mainland China or outside mainland China, do you look to deploy your assets in terms of expansion?
segments.zh: 好的，Ricky，除了当前项目，你们还计划在中国内地或海外哪些地方扩展资产部署？

segments.en: Yeah, yeah, that's a very good question. Actually, our angle is a bit different, so we will try to find a place which have a boundary renewable energy, which can somehow solve the energy challenges for the data center booming.
segments.zh: 这个问题很好。我们的角度略有不同，我们会寻找可再生能源丰富的地方，以解决数据中心激增带来的能源挑战。

segments.en: So, mostly we are looking for the place with renewable energy, so in China, in Inamongolia and other place in the western China, or the northern China will be very ideal to us, and we are also exploring that.
segments.zh: 因此，我们主要寻找可再生能源丰富的地点，在中国，内蒙古和中国西部、北部地区非常理想，我们也在探索。

segments.en: And outside of it, actually there's quite a lot of places including Latin America, and maybe some south part of Europe and Africa, or even Southeast Asia, there are all the places we are looking for to build some data center for the local consumptions.
segments.zh: 此外，还有很多地方包括拉丁美洲、南欧和非洲，甚至东南亚，都是我们考虑建设数据中心供当地使用的地点。
